description: Good decision: the dev-mode error messages in reader/main.rs (lines 354-360 and 366-375) interpolate the actual listen address from config so the operator sees which address triggered the guard, state exactly what is wrong (auth.required = false, no users configured), give two concrete remedies numbered (1) and (2), and for the signing-key case include the exact command to run (stoa-reader keygen --output <path>). This reduces time-to-resolution from 'read the docs' to 'copy the command'.
title: DECISION: actionable error messages name address and remedy
